events.title: European Shares Seen Lower Before Big Tech Earnings, Fed Decision
events.description: European stocks are seen opening lower on Wednesday as investors await cues from tech earnings and the upcoming Federal Reserve's interest-rate decision.

events.title: Indian Shares Notably Lower As IT Stocks Drag
events.description: Indian shares fell notably in early trade on Wednesday, with Information technology stocks coming under heavy selling pressure after an AI-fueled tech rally sent U.S. stocks to a higher close on Tuesday.

events.title: Australian Market Pares Early Gains In Mid-market
events.description: The Australian stock market is paring its early gains in mid-market moves on Wednesday, but extending the gains in the previous three sessions, with the benchmark S&P/ASX 200 moving above the 8,850 level, following the broadly positive cues from Wall Street overnight, with gains across most sectors led by mining and technology stocks.

events.title: Asian Markets Mixed Amid Cautious Trades
events.description: Asian markets are mixed on Wednesday, following the positive cues from Wall Street overnight, amid easing crude oil prices and a spike in semiconductor stocks on renewed optimism about the AI trade after AI giant Anthropic publicly filed for an IPO on Monday. The uncertainty in the Middle East weighed on market sentiment as efforts by regional intermediaries to defuse Middle East tensions continue

events.title: Indian Shares Seen Little Changed At Open
events.description: Indian shares are seen opening little changed on Wednesday despite firm cues from global markets. Shares of Reliance Industries would be in focus as Jio Platforms makes its stock market debut.

events.title: Thai Stock Market May Reverse Tuesday's Losses
events.description: The Thai stock market on Tuesday snapped the three-day winning streak in which it had climbed almost 25 points or 1.4 percent. The Stock Exchange of Thailand now sits just above the 1,575-point plateau although it's likely to see renewed support on Wednesday.

events.title: Indonesia Stock Market Tipped To Open To The Upside
events.description: The Indonesia stock market turned lower again on Tuesday, one day after ending the four-day winning streak in which it had jumped almost 450 points or 8.6 percent. The Jakarta Composite Index now sits just beneath the 5,270-point plateau although it's expected to cut into those losses on Wednesday.

events.title: Japanese Market Sharply Higher
events.description: The Japanese stock market is trading sharply higher on Wednesday, extending the gains in the previous session, following the broadly positive cues from Wall Street overnight. The Nikkei 225 is moving up to near the 64,000 level, with gains in index heavyweights and technology stocks.

events.title: Higher Open Called For Hong Kong Stock Market
events.description: The Hong Kong stock market on Tuesday ended the two-day winning streak in which it had picked up more than 275 points or 1.2 percent. The Hang Seng now sits just beneath the 23,050-point plateau although it's expected to rebound again on Wednesday.

events.title: Australian Market Notably Higher
events.description: Australian shares are trading notably higher on Wednesday, extending the gains in the previous three sessions, with the benchmark S&P/ASX 200 moving above the 8,900 level, following the broadly positive cues from Wall Street overnight, with gains across most sectors led by mining and technology stocks.

events.title: Rebound Anticipated For China Stock Market
events.description: The China stock market on Tuesday snapped the two-day winning streak in which it had gained almost 40 points or 1.1 percent. The Shanghai Composite Index now sits just beneath the 3,650-point plateau although it's expected to move back to the upside again on Wednesday.

events.title: Taiwan Stock Market May See Additional Support On Wednesday
events.description: The Taiwan stock market has finished higher in two of three trading days since the end of the two-day losing streak in which it had given up almost 820 points or 1.7 percent. The Taiwan Stock Exchange now sits just beneath the 46,100-point plateau and it's expected to open in the green again on Wednesday.

events.title: Singapore Stock Market May Find Traction On Wednesday
events.description: The Singapore stock market has finished lower in back-to-back sessions, slipping more than 25 points or 0.4 percent in that span. The STI now sits just beneath the 5,400-point plateau although it may stop the bleeding on Wednesday.
